context: Patronage: a cop's retirement party at the Shamrock Rail.

lines.speaker: npc.off_duty_cop
lines.text: Mr. Varelas! You're buying the round? Everybody, Mr. Varelas is buying!

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Everybody gets paid. Tonight it's whiskey.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Somebody's taking pictures by the door. Tall woman. I'd know that bag anywhere.
